Description: "The payment breakdown was incorrect because: (1) SPLIT orders had payment_method='SPLIT' which didn't match any of the Card/Cash/UPI checks, so they were completely dropped. (2) All orders used total_price instead of paid_amount, so non-SPLIT amounts were also wrong when change was saved to balance. Now correctly uses paid_amount for the actual payment portion, and adds a Credit row."
Instruction: "Fix the payment breakdown calculation to correctly handle SPLIT payments by using paid_amount for the cash/card portion and credit_amount for the credit portion. Also handle DUE/CREDIT orders properly, and show Credit in the breakdown."
